title: Ghost PowerToys Run window when using Win+, while PowerToys Run is open

judgment.rationale: The issue already provides a two-step trigger and a screenshot, and PowerToys Run has an explicit HideWhenDeactivated path that can be validated locally first.
evidence: The trigger is: open PowerToys Run, then press Win+,.
The issue includes a screenshot of the stale ghost window.
MainWindow.xaml.cs hides the launcher on deactivation when HideWhenDeactivated is enabled.
judgment.recommended_action: Run a maintainer-side repro against the launcher deactivation path.

fix_assessment.rationale: The symptom is repro-ready, but this fast pass stops short of choosing one launcher fix.

issue_context.summary: Pressing Win+, while PowerToys Run is already open leaves a ghost launcher window instead of cleanly dismissing the surface.
known_information: PowerToys Run 0.100.2 from the Microsoft Store.
Win+D does not reproduce the same behavior.
A screenshot attachment is already present.
inferences: The bug likely involves launcher deactivation/hide rather than the query pipeline.
The trigger is concise enough that maintainer-side reproduction is more useful than another log request.
issue_context.analysis: The artifact keeps this in a reproduce state because the two-step trigger already points to a narrow, local validation path.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the issue body and screenshot reference.
Reviewed PowerLauncher/MainWindow.xaml.cs and confirmed the HideWhenDeactivated path.

actions.label: Reproduce ghost PowerToys Run window
actions.note: Validate launcher deactivation when Win+, opens Settings while Run is visible.

reproduce.version: PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer current main build
prerequisites: Enable PowerToys Run with hide-on-deactivate behavior.
steps: Press Win+, while the launcher window is still visible.
Observe whether Settings opens and a ghost launcher window remains instead of the Run surface dismissing cleanly.
reproduce.expected_result: The launcher should fully dismiss when Win+, shifts focus to Settings.

confidence.rationale: Trigger is concise and owning path is narrow.
